name: graph_query
description: Run one read-only Cypher query (Kuzu dialect) against the knowledge graph and get JSON rows back (at most 200 rows). Nodes: Episode(id), Passage(id), Claim(id), Entity(id, name, kind), Thesis(id). Relationships: (Episode)-[:CONTAINS]->(Passage), (Claim)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(Passage), (Claim)-[:ABOUT]->(Entity), (Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(Entity), (Claim)-[:SUPPORTS]->(Thesis), (Claim)-[:CHALLENGES]->(Thesis), (Thesis)-[:ABOUT]->(Entity). Node ids are the Postgres UUIDs; fetch claim and passage text with postgres_database_query.
